G4370: To run to. From pros and trecho; to run towards, i.e. Hasten to meet or join.
G848: Her own, his own, their own, themselves, they. Contracted for heautou; self.
G3812: From childhood, from early boyhood. Adverb from paidion; from infancy.
G875: To foam (at the mouth), froth. From aphros; to froth at the mouth.
G5149: To grate, gnash (as the teeth). Apparently a primary verb; to creak, i.e. to grate the teeth.
G4952: To throw violently on the ground. From sun and sparasso; to rend completely, i.e. to convulse violently.
G2947: To roll, roll along, wallow. From the base of kuma; to roll about.
G1998: To run together again. From epi and suntrecho; to hasten together upon one place.
G1723: To take (fold) in my arms. From en and a derivative of agkale; to take in one's arms, i.e. Embrace.
G4029: From peri and keimai; to lie all around, i.e. Inclose, encircle, hamper.
G4663: A gnawing worm; gnawing anguish. Of uncertain derivation; a grub, maggot or earth-worm.
G741: Prop: I arrange, make ready; I season, flavor. From a presumed derivative of airo; to prepare, i.e. Spice.
G1514: To be peaceful, keep the peace, be at peace. From eirene; to be peaceful.
G4848: From sun and poreuomai; to journey together; by implication, to assemble.
G4347: From pros and kollao; to glue to, i.e. to adhere.
G650: To defraud, deprive of, despoil; mid: I endure deprivation; pass: To be bereft of. From apo and stereo; to despoil.
G1422: Difficult, hard; of persons: hard to please. From dus- and kolon; properly, fastidious about eating, i.e. impracticable.
G4365: To come to, approach. From pros and poreuomai; to journey towards, i.e. Approach.
G4319: To beg, ask earnestly, ask for in addition. From pros and aiteo; to ask repeatedly, i.e. Solicit.
G924: Bartimaeus, son of (?) Timaeus. Of Chaldee origin; son of Timoeus; Bar-timoeus, an Israelite.
G5090: Timaeus, father of the blind beggar Bartimaeus. Probably of Chaldee origin; Timoeus, an Israelite.
G577: To throw away from, throw overboard, cast aside. From apo and ballo; to throw off; figuratively, to lose.
G1530: To leap into, rush into. From eis and pedao; to rush in.
G296: Prop: a road around anything; the street of a village. From the base of amphoteros and hodos; a fork in the road.
G4746: A bough, branch of a tree. From a primary steibo; a spread of loose materials for a couch, i.e. a bough of a tree so employed.
G363: To remind, admonish, be reminded, remind myself; pass: I remember, recall. From ana and mimnesko; to remind; to recollect.
G5276: Neuter of a presumed compound of hupo and lenos; vessel or receptacle under the press, i.e. Lower wine-vat.
G2775: To wound in the head. From the same as kephalaion; to strike on the head.
G64: To catch, capture. From agra; to hunt, i.e. to entrap.
G1817: From ek and anistemi; objectively, to produce, i.e. beget; subjectively, to arise, i.e. object.
G2479: Strength (absolutely), power, might, force, ability. From a derivative of is; forcefulness.
G3646: A whole burnt offering. From a derivative of a compound of holos and a derivative of kaio; a wholly-consumed sacrifice.
G4749: A long robe, worn by the upper classes in the East. From stello; equipment, i.e., a |stole| or long-fitting gown.
G5503: Feminine of a presumed derivative apparently from the base of chasma through the idea of deficiency; a widow, literally or figuratively.
G4392: A pretext, an excuse. From a compound of pro and phaino; an outward showing, i.e. Pretext.
G3117: Long, distant, far; of long duration. From mekos; long (distant) or time (neuter plural).
G1049: A treasury. From gaza and phulake; a treasure-house, i.e. A court in the temple for the collection-boxes.
G3016: Neuter of a derivative of the same as lepis; something scaled, i.e. A small coin.
G5304: Poverty, want, need. A falling short, i.e., penury.
G979: A primary word; life, i.e. the present state of existence; by implication, the means of livelihood.
G4931: To bring to an end, fulfill, accomplish. From sun and teleo; to complete entirely; generally, to execute.
G4305: To be anxious beforehand, ponder beforehand. From pro and merimnao; to care in advance.
G1586: To pick out for myself, choose, elect, select. Middle voice from ek and lego; to select.
G635: To cause to go astray; pass: To be led astray. From apo and planao; to lead astray; passively, to stray.
G69: Ultimately from a and hupnos; to be sleepless, i.e. Keep awake.
G590: Away from home, sojourning in another country. From apo and demos; absent from one's own people, i.e. A foreign traveller.
G3317: Midnight, the middle of the period between sunset and sunrise. Neuter of compound of mesos and nux; midnight.
G219: From alektor and phone; cock-crow, i.e. The third night-watch.
G4185: Very costly, very precious, of great value. From polus and telos; extremely expensive.
G4101: Genuine, pure (of ointment), trustworthy. From pistis; trustworthy, i.e. Genuine.
G3487: Spikenard, a perfume made originally from a plant growing on the Himalayas. Of foreign origin; |nard|.
G4301: From pro and lambano; to take in advance, i.e. eat before others have an opportunity; to anticipate, surprise.
G1780: Embalming, preparation of a body for burial. From entaphiazo; preparation for interment.
G1861: From epi and the base of aggelos; to announce upon, i.e. to engage to do something, to assert something respecting oneself.
G2765: A pitcher, earthen vessel, jar. Neuter of a presumed derivative of keramos; an earthenware vessel, i.e. Jar.
G528: To go to meet, meet, encounter. From apo and a derivative of anti; to meet away, i.e. Encounter.
G508: From ano and ge; above the ground, i.e. the second floor of a building; used for a dome or a balcony on the upper story.
G4880: To die together with. From sun and apothnesko; to decease in company with, or, similarly to.
G3911: From para and phero; to bear along or aside, i.e. Carry off; by implication, to avert.
G2599: To burden, oppress, weigh down. From kata and bareo; to impose upon.
G4953: A signal agreed upon. Neuter of a compound of sun and the base of semaino; a sign in common, i.e. Preconcerted signal.
G4685: To draw (as a sword), pull. A primary verb; to draw.
G4775: To sit with. From sun and kathemai; to seat oneself in company with.
G2328: To warm; mid: I warm myself. From therme; to heat.
G5499: Done or made with hands, artificial. From cheir and a derivative of poieo; manufactured, i.e. Of human construction.
G886: Not made with hands. Unmanufactured, i.e. Inartificial.
G2128: (used only of God), blessed (as entitled to receive blessing from man), worthy of praise. From eulogeo; adorable.
G4028: To cover up, cover round about, veil round, blindfold. From peri and kalupto; to cover all around, i.e. Entirely.
G4475: A slap, blow on the cheek with the open hand. From rhapizo; a slap.
G4259: A porch, court before a building, vestibule. Neuter of a presumed compound of pro and aule; a forecourt, i.e. Vestibule.
G332: To curse, invoke curses, devote to destruction. From anathema; to declare or vow under penalty of execration.
G3868: From para and the middle voice of aiteo; to beg off, i.e. Deprecate, decline, shun.
G4955: A fellow insurgent. From a compound of sun and a derivative of stasis; a fellow-insurgent.
G4714: From the base of histemi; a standing, i.e. position; by implication, a popular uprising; figuratively, controversy.
G383: To shake up, stir up, excite. From ana and seio; figuratively, to excite.
G1737: (somewhat rare) (of clothing: I put on another); mid: I put on (myself). A prolonged form of enduo; to invest.
G4209: Of Latin origin; the |purple| mussel, i.e. the red-blue color itself, and finally a garment dyed with it.
G1806: To lead out, sometimes to death, execution. From ek and ago; to lead forth.
G223: From the same as alektor and aner; man-defender; Alexander, the name of three Israelites and one other man.
G4669: To mingle with myrrh. From Smurna; to tincture with myrrh, i.e. Embitter.
G1682: (Aramaic), my God. Of Chaldean origin my God.
G1924: To write upon, inscribe, imprint a mark on. From epi and grapho; to inscribe.
G2507: (a) I take down, pull down, depose, destroy. From kata and haireomai; to lower demolish.
G1606: (lit: I breathe out), I breathe my last, expire. From ek and pneo; to expire.
G4539: Salome, wife of Zebedee and mother of James and John, the apostles. Probably of Hebrew origin; Salome, an Israelitess.
G4872: To go up with. From sun and anabaino; to ascend in company with.
G4315: The day before the Sabbath. From pro and sabbaton; a fore-sabbath, i.e. The Sabbath-eve.
G2158: From eu and schema; well-formed, i.e. decorous, noble.
G1010: From bouleuo; an adviser, i.e. a councillor or member of the Jewish Sanhedrin.
G1433: To give, grant, donate. Middle voice from doron; to bestow gratuitously.
G1750: To wrap up, roll up in (something), wind in. From ennomos and the base of heilisso; to enwrap.
G1230: To pass (of time); I continue through, intervene. From dia and ginomai; to elapse meanwhile.
G569: To be unfaithful, disbelieve, refuse belief, prove false. From apistos; to be unbelieving, i.e. disbelieve, or disobey.
G3444: Form, shape, outward appearance. Perhaps from the base of meros; shape; figuratively, nature.
G5023: This; he, she, it. Nominative or accusative case neuter plural of houtos; these things.
G984: To hurt, injure. A primary verb; properly, to hinder, i.e. to injure.
G353: To take up, raise; I pick up, take on board; I carry off, lead away. From ana and lambano; to take up.
G4903: To cooperate with, work together. From sunergos; to be a fellow-worker, i.e. Co-operate.
G1895: Since, forasmuch as. From epeide and per; since indeed.
G392: From ana and the middle voice of tasso; to arrange.
G950: To confirm, ratify, secure, establish; pass: I guarantee. From bebaios; to stabilitate.
G1872: To follow close after, accompany, dog; I imitate, pursue, be studious of. From epi and akoloutheo; to accompany.
G2021: To take in hand, attempt. From epi and cheir; to put the hand upon, i.e. Undertake.
G4135: From pleres and phoreo; to carry out fully, i.e. Completely assure, entirely accomplish.
G3877: From para and akoloutheo; to follow near, i.e. attend, trace out, conform to.
G2903: Superlative of a derivative of kratos; strongest, i.e. very honorable.
G2727: To instruct orally, teach, inform. From kata and echos; to sound down into the ears, i.e. to indoctrinate or to apprise of.
G2183: From ephemeros; diurnality, i.e. the quotidian rotation or class of the Jewish priests' service at the Temple, as distributed by families.
G2: Aaron, son of Amram and Jochebed, brother of Moses. Of Hebrew origin; Aaron, the brother of Moses.
G2407: To serve as priest. Prolongation from hiereus; to be a priest, i.e. Perform his functions.
G2975: A prolonged form of a primary verb, which is only used as an alternate in certain tenses; to lot, i.e. Determine especially by lot.
G2405: The duty (office) of a priest, priesthood. From hierateuo; priestliness, i.e. The sacerdotal function.
G2370: To burn incense. From a derivative of thuo; to fumigate, i.e. Offer aromatic fumes.
G2368: Incense. From thumiao; an aroma, i.e. Fragrant powder burnt in religious service; by implication, the burning itself.
G20: Wild joy, ecstatic delight, exultation, exhilaration. From agalliao; exultation; specially, welcome.
G4608: Intoxicating drink. Of Hebrew origin; an intoxicant, i.e. Intensely fermented liquor.
G545: Unbelieving, disobedient, who will not be persuaded. Unpersuadable, i.e. Contumacious.
G3701: A vision, supernatural appearance. From a presumed derivative of optanomai; visuality, i.e. an apparition.
G1269: To nod continually, beckon. From dia and neuo; to nod across an intervening space.
G1265: To remain, continue. From dia and meno; to stay constantly.
G4032: To conceal, hide (by putting something around it). From peri and krupto; to conceal all around, i.e. Entirely.
G1896: To looked upon, regarded. And other moods and persons of the same tense; from epi and eido; to regard.
G5487: To favor, bestow freely on. From charis; to grace, i.e. Indue with special honor.
G1298: To trouble greatly, agitate. From dia and tarasso; to disturb wholly, i.e. Agitate.
G1904: From epi and erchomai; to supervene, i.e. Arrive, occur, impend, attack, influence.
G1094: Old age. Akin to geron; senility.
G3714: Mountainous, hilly, the hill-country. From oros; mountainous, i.e. the Highlands.
G4640: To leap (for joy), skip, bound. Akin to skairo; to jump, i.e. Sympathetically move.
G400: To call out, shout, exclaim. From ana and phoneo; to exclaim.
G5050: Completion, fulfillment, perfection. From phusioo; completion, i.e. verification, or absolution.
G1914: To look with favor on, regard. From epi and blepo; to gaze at.
G5014: Abasement (in spirit), low condition (in circumstances). From tapeinoo; depression.
G3106: To bless, pronounce blessed or happy. From makarios; to beatify, i.e. Pronounce fortunate.
G1023: The arm, strength. Properly, comparative of brachus, but apparently in the sense of brasso; the arm, i.e. strength.
G5244: Proud, arrogant, disdainful. From huper and phaino; appearing above others, i.e. haughty.
G1413: (lit: a man who rules by force), a ruler, potentate; also: courtier, member of the court. From dunamai; a ruler or officer.
G1705: To fill up, satisfy. Or empletho em-play'-tho; from en and the base of pleistos;to fill in, i.e. to satisfy.
G1821: From ek and apostello; to send away forth, i.e. to despatch, or to dismiss.
G482: From anti and the middle voice of lambano; to take hold of in turn, i.e. Succor; also to participate.
G4040: Dwelling around; subst: a neighbor. From peri and oikos; housed around, i.e. Neighboring.
G4796: To rejoice with, congratulate. From sun and chairo; to sympathize in gladness, congratulate.
G4059: To cut around, circumcise. From peri and the base of tomoteros; to cut around, i.e. to circumcise.
G4772: Kindred, family. From suggenes; relationship, i.e. relatives.
G1770: To make a sign to by nodding. From en and neuo; to nod at, i.e. Beckon or communicate by gesture.
G4093: A tablet for writing. Diminutive of pinax; a tablet.
G4039: To dwell around, be neighboring to. From peri and oikeo; to reside around, i.e. Be a neighbor.
G1255: From dia and laleo; to talk throughout a company, i.e. Converse or publish.
G2958: Cyrenius or Quirinius, governor of Syria. Of Latin origin; Cyrenius, a Roman.
G1471: With child, pregnant. From en and the base of kuma; swelling inside, i.e. Pregnant.
G4313: To precede, pass on before, go before. From pro and poreuomai; to precede.
G5311: Height, heaven; dignity, eminence. From a derivative of huper; elevation, i.e. altitude, the sky, or dignity.
G2720: (a) I make straight, (b) met: I put in the right way, direct. From kata and euthuno; to straighten fully, i.e. direct.
G2901: To strengthen, confirm; pass: I grow strong, become strong. From krataios; to empower, i.e. increase in vigor.
G582: An enrollment, census-taking, record. From apographo; an enrollment; by implication, an assessment.
G2230: To govern. From hegemon; to act as ruler.
G3965: Lineage, ancestry; a family, tribe. As if feminine of a derivative of pater; paternal descent, i.e. a group of families or a whole race.
G4416: First-born, eldest. From protos and the alternate of tikto; first-born.
G4683: To swathe, wrap in swaddling clothes. From sparganon; to swathe.
G63: To spend the night in the open, bivouac. From agros and auleo; to camp out.
G2186: To stand by, be urgent, befall one (as of evil), be at hand, impend. From epi and histemi; to stand upon, i.e. Be present.
G4034: To shine around. From peri and lampo; to illuminate all around, i.e. Invest with a halo.
G4756: Feminine of a derivative of stratos; camp-likeness, i.e. An army, i.e. the angels, the celestial luminaries.
G1107: To make known, declare, know, discover. From a derivative of ginosko; to make known; subjectively, to know.
G4692: To hasten, urge on, desire earnestly. Probably strengthened from pous; to |speed|, i.e. Urge on; by implication, to await eagerly.
G429: To find by seeking out, discover. From ana and heurisko; to find out.
G1521: To lead in, bring in, introduce. From eis and ago; to introduce.
G4820: From sun and ballo; to combine, i.e. to converse, consult, dispute, to consider, to aid, to join, attack.
G1480: To accustom. From ethos; to accustom, i.e. customary.
G4992: Saving, bringing salvation; subst: salvation. Neuter of the same as soteria as noun; defender or defence.
G602: An unveiling, uncovering, revealing, revelation. From apokalupto; disclosure.
G483: To speak or say in opposition, contradict (oppose, resist). From anti and lego; to dispute, refuse.
G4501: A sword, scimitar; fig: war, piercing grief. Probably of foreign origin; a sabre, i.e. A long and broad cutlass.
G4398: A prophetess. Feminine of prophetes; a female foreteller or an inspired woman.
G451: Anna, a prophetess, who visited the infant Jesus. Of Hebrew origin; Anna, an Israelitess.
G5323: Phanuel, father of Anna the prophetess. Of Hebrew origin; Phanuel, an Israelite.
G768: Asher, one of the sons of Jacob, and founder of one of the Twelve Tribes. Of Hebrew origin; Aser, an Israelite tribe.
G3521: Fasting, the day of atonement. From nesteuo; abstinence; specially, the fast of the Day of Atonement.
G437: From anti and the middle voice of homologeo; to confess in turn, i.e. Respond in praise.
G4923: A company traveling together, a caravan. From a compound of sun and hodos; companionship on a journey, i.e., a caravan.
G327: To seek out, search for (implying the difficulty of the task). From ana and zeteo; to search out.
G3600: To torment, pain; mid. and pass: To be tormented, pained; I suffer acute pain, physical or mental. From odune; to grieve.
G2484: Of Hebrew origin; Ituraea, a region of Palestine.
G9: Of foreign origin; Abilene, a region of Syria.
G1301: To keep safe, hold fast. From dia and tereo; to watch thoroughly, i.e. to observe strictly, or to avoid wholly.
G5086: Of Latin origin; probably pertaining to the river Tiberis or Tiber; Tiberius, a Roman emperor.
G5075: To rule over as a tetrarch. From tetrarches; to be a tetrarch.
G5139: From a derivative of trachus; rough district; Trachonitis, a region of Syria.
G3078: Lysanias, tetrarch of Abilene. From lusis and ania; grief-dispelling; Lysanias, a governor of Abilene.
G5327: A valley, ravine, chasm, cleft. Properly, strengthened from the base of peran or rather of rhegnumi; a gap or chasm, i.e. Ravine.
G4646: Crooked, perverse, unfair, curved, tortuous. From the base of skelos; warped, i.e. Winding; figuratively, perverse.
G5138: Rough, rugged, uneven. Perhaps strengthened from the base of rhegnumi; uneven, rocky.
G4754: To wage war, fight, serve as a soldier; fig: of the warring lusts against the soul.
G1286: To blackmail, extort from, intimidate. From dia and seio; to shake thoroughly, i.e. to intimidate.
G4811: From a compound of sukon and a derivative of phaino; to be a fig-informer, |sycophant|, i.e. to defraud.
G3800: Neuter of a presumed derivative of the same as opsarion; rations for a soldier, i.e. his stipend or pay.
G2623: To shut up, confine. From kata and kleio; to shut down, i.e. Incarcerate.
G1443: Eber, father of Peleg and son of Shelah. Of Hebrew origin; Eber, a patriarch.
G4527: Sala, the name of two of the ancestors of Jesus. Of Hebrew origin; Sala, a patriarch.
G4590: Shem, a son of Noah. Of Hebrew origin; Sem, a patriarch.
G1491: Visible form, shape, appearance, outward show, kind, species, class. From eido; a view, i.e. Form.
G3158: Matthat, an ancestor of Jesus. Probably a shortened form of Mattathias; Matthat, the name of two Israelites.
G3197: Melchi, one of the ancestors of Jesus. Of Hebrew origin; Melchi, the name of two Israelites.
G3161: Mattathias, an ancestor of Jesus. Of Hebrew origin; Mattathias, an Israelite and a Christian.
G3477: Naggai, one of the ancestors of Jesus. Probably of Hebrew origin; Nangae, an Israelite.
G3092: (Hebrew), Maath, an ancestor of Jesus. Probably of Hebrew origin; Maath, an Israelite.
G4584: Semein, an ancestor of Jesus. Of Hebrew origin; Semei, an Israelite.
G2490: Joanan, a proper name. A form of Ioannes; Joannas, an Israelite.
G4488: Rhesa, an ancestor of Jesus. Probably of Hebrew origin; Resa, an Israelite.
G3518: Neri, an ancestor of Jesus. Of Hebrew origin; Neri, an Israelite.
G78: Addi, son of Cosam, and father of Melchi, one of the ancestors of Jesus. Probably of Hebrew origin; Addi, an Israelite.
G1663: Eliezer, son of Joram and father of Joshua. Of Hebrew origin; Eliezer, an Israelite.
G2497: (Hebrew), Jorim, an ancestor of Jesus. Perhaps for Ioram; Jorim, an Israelite.
G2494: (Hebrew), Jonam, an ancestor of Jesus. Probably for Ioannes or Ionas; Jonan, an Israelite.
G3190: Melea, one of the ancestors of Jesus. Of uncertain origin; Meleas, an Israelite.
G3104: Menna, Mainan, a proper name. Probably of Hebrew origin; Mainan, an Israelite.
G3160: Mattatha. Probably a shortened form of Mattathias; Mattatha, an Israelite.
G3481: Nathan, son of David, and an ancestor of Jesus. Of Hebrew origin; Nathan, an Israelite.
G3493: Nahor, one of the ancestors of Jesus. Of Hebrew origin; Nachor, the grandfather of Abraham.
G5317: Peleg, son of Eber, and one of the ancestors of Jesus. Of Hebrew origin; Phalek, a patriarch.
G2536: (Hebrew), Cainan, one of the ancestors of Jesus. Of Hebrew origin; Cainan, the name of two patriarchs.
G742: Arphaxad, son of Shem, and father of Cainan. Of Hebrew origin; Arphaxad, a post-diluvian patriarch.
G2984: (Hebrew), Lamech, son of Methuselah and father of Noah. Of Hebrew origin; Lamech, a patriarch.
G3103: (Hebrew) Methuselah, son of Enoch and father of Lamech. Of Hebrew origin; Mathusala, an antediluvian.
G2391: (Hebrew), Jared, son of Mahalalel and father of Enoch. Of Hebrew origin; Jared, an antediluvian.
G3121: Mahalaleel or Maleleel, one of the ancestors of Jesus. Of Hebrew origin; Maleleel, an antediluvian.
G1800: Enosh (also Enos), son of Seth, and father of Cainan. Of Hebrew origin; Enos, a patriarch.
G76: Adam, the first man, the first parent of the human race. Of Hebrew origin; Adam, the first man; typically man.
G4743: A moment, point of time, an instant. Feminine of stigma; a point of time, i.e. An instant.
G1314: To guard carefully, protect, defend. From dia and phulasso; to guard thoroughly, i.e. Protect.
G380: To unroll, roll back, unfold. From ana and ptusso; to unroll.
G5548: Probably akin to chraomai through the idea of contact; to smear or rub with oil, i.e. to consecrate to an office or religious service.
G164: A captive (in war), a prisoner. From aichme and a derivative of the same as halosis; properly, a prisoner of war, i.e. a captive.
G2352: To crush, break, shatter; met: I break down. A primary verb; to crush.
G4428: To fold, roll up (as a scroll). Probably akin to petannumi; to fold, i.e. Furl a scroll.
G816: To direct my gaze, look steadily. From a compound of a and teino; to gaze intently.
G3843: Wholly, entirely, in every way, by all means, certainly. Adverb from pas; entirely; specially, at all events, in no event.
G4558: Zarephath, a town in the district of Sidon in Phoenicia. Of Hebrew origin; Sarepta, a place in Palestine.
G3790: The brow, a ridge (of a mountain). Perhaps from optanomai; the eye-|brow| or forehead, i.e. the brink of a precipice.
G2630: To cast down headlong, throw over a precipice. From kata and a derivative of kremnos; to precipitate down.
G1436: Apparent imperative of eao; properly, let it be, i.e. aha!
G2285: Astonishment, amazement (allied to terror or awe). Akin to an obsolete tapho; stupefaction, i.e. Astonishment.
G2279: (a) a sound, noise, (b) a rumor, report. Of uncertain affinity; a loud or confused noise, i.e. Roar; figuratively, a rumor.
G576: From apo and the base of basis; literally, to disembark; figuratively, to eventuate.
G4150: To wash. A prolonged form of an obsolete pluo; to |plunge|, i.e. Launder clothing.
G4788: To enclose, shut in, make subject to. From sun and kleio; to shut together, i.e. Include or embrace in a common subjection to.
G2656: To nod, make a sign, beckon. From kata and neuo; to nod down, i.e. to make signs to.
G3353: A sharer, partner, associate. From metecho; participant, i.e. a sharer; by implication, an associate.
G1036: To cause to sink; mid: I sink, submerge, drown. From buthos; to sink; by implication, to drown.
G2221: To capture alive, capture for life, enthrall. From the same as zoon and agreuo; to take alive, i.e. to capture or ensnare.
G2609: From kata and ago; to lead down; specially, to moor a vessel.
G5298: To withdraw, retire, go back, retreat. From hupo and choreo; to vacate down, i.e. Retire quietly.
G3547: A teacher and interpreter of the Mosaic Law. From nomos and didaskalos; an expounder of the law, i.e. A Rabbi.
G3886: To relax, enfeeble, weaken. From para and luo; to loosen beside, i.e. Relax.
G2826: A couch or litter of a sick person. Neuter of a presumed derivative of kline; a pallet or little couch.
G2766: A tile; practically: the roof. Probably from the base of kerannumi; earthenware, i.e. A tile.
G1403: A feast, banquet, reception. From dechomai; a reception, i.e. Convivial entertainment.
G3861: Unexpected, strange, wonderful, astonishing. From para and doxa; contrary to expectation, i.e. Extraordinary.
G5198: From hugies; to have sound health, i.e. Be well; figuratively, to be uncorrupt.
G4437: Frequent, often, much. From the same as skenopoios; clasped, i.e. frequent; neuter plural frequently.
G1279: To journey through (past). From dia and poreuomai; to travel through.
G5597: To rub, rub to pieces. Prolongation from the same base as psallo; to triturate, i.e. to rub out.
G454: Folly, madness, foolishness. From a compound of a and nous; stupidity; by implication, rage.
G1273: To spend the whole night. From dia and a derivative of nux; to sit up the whole night.
G2207: One who is eagerly devoted to a person or a thing, a zealot. From zeloo; a |zealot|.
G3977: Level, low-lying, flat. From a derivative of pous; level.
G3882: Adjacent to the sea, on the coast. From para and hals; beside the salt, i.e. Maritime.
G1776: To disturb, cause tumult, trouble, annoy. From en and ochleo; to crowd in, i.e. to annoy.
G5212: Your, yours. From humeis; yours, i.e. Pertaining to you.
G884: Ungrateful, ungracious, unpleasing. Thankless, i.e. Ungrateful.
G1908: To insult, treat wrongfully, molest, revile. From a comparative of epi and areia; to insult, slander.
G523: To ask back, ask what is my due, demand back. From apo and aiteo; to demand back.
G560: To give up in despair, despair of; I hope to receive from or in return. From apo and elpizo; to hope out, i.e. Fully expect.
G4085: To press down, press together, as in a measure. Another form for piazo; to pack.
G5240: To pour out so that it overflows. From huper and the alternate form of ekcheo; to pour out over, i.e. to overflow.
G488: To measure in return, give equivalent measure. From anti and metreo; to mete in return.
G5166: To gather (as of grapes), harvest. From a derivative of trugo meaning ripe fruit; to collect the vintage.
G4393: To bring forth, produce. From pro and phero; to bear forward, i.e. Produce.
G4485: What is broken, a ruin. From rhegnumi; something torn, i.e. A fragment.
G4366: To dash against, as waves. From pros and rhegnumi; to tear towards, i.e. Burst upon.
G1894: Of time: when, now, after that; of cause: seeing that, forasmuch as. From epei and de; since now, i.e. when, or whereas.
G1784: (held precious, hence) precious, honored, honorable in rank. From en and time; valued.
G515: To account or treat as worthy. From axios; to deem entitled or fit.
G3484: Nain, a city south-west of the Sea of Galilee. Probably of Hebrew origin; Nain, a place in Palestine.
G1580: To carry out (of the city gate for burial). From ek and komizo; to bear forth.
G4673: A bier, an open coffin. Probably akin to the base of soreuo; a funereal receptacle, i.e. a bier.
G339: To sit up. From ana and kathizo; properly, to set up, i.e. to sit up.
G934: Courtiers, palaces, a body of kings, royal. From basileus; kingly.
G1741: Highly esteemed, splendid, glorious. From en and doxa; in glory, i.e. Splendid, noble.
G5172: From thrupto (figuratively) enfeeble, especially the mind and body by indulgence); effeminacy, i.e. Luxury or debauchery.
G2625: From kata and klino; to recline down, i.e. to take a place at table.
G1591: To wipe, wipe (off) thoroughly. From ek and the base of massaomai; to knead out, i.e. to wipe dry.
G5533: A debtor. From a derivative of chrao and opheiletes; a loan-ower, i.e. Indebted person.
G5274: (a) I take up, (b) I welcome, entertain, (c) I answer, (d) I suppose, imagine.
G1257: To cease, give over, give up. From dia and leipo; to leave off in the middle, i.e. Intermit.
G1353: To journey through, go about. From dia and hodeuo; to travel through.
G2489: (Hebrew), Joanna, Johanna, wife of Chuza, Herod's steward. Feminine of the same as Ioannes; Joanna, a Christian.
G4677: Susannah, a woman of the retinue of Jesus. Of Hebrew origin; lily; Susannah, an Israelitess.
G4896: To come together. From sun and eimi; to assemble.
G1975: To travel, journey (to). From epi and poreuomai; to journey further, i.e. Travel on.
G4855: To grow at the same time. From sun and phuo; passive, to grow jointly.
G638: (a) I suffocate, choke, drown, (b) I stop the growth of. From apo and pnigo; to stifle.
G5052: To bring to maturity. From a compound of telos and phero; to be a bearer to completion, i.e. To ripen fruit.
G681: To kindle, light. A primary verb; properly, to fasten to, i.e. to set on fire.
G4940: To meet with, come to, fall in with. From sun and tugchano; to chance together, i.e. Meet with.
G4126: Another form for pleuo; which is used as an alternate in certain tenses; probably a form of pluno; to pass in a vessel.
G879: To fall asleep. From a compound of apo and hupnos; properly, to become awake, i.e. to drop in slumber.
G4845: To fill completely; pass: To be completed. From sun and pleroo; to implenish completely, i.e. to swamp, or to accomplish.
G2793: To be in danger or peril. From kindunos; to undergo peril.
G2830: Rough water, a wave, billow, surge. From kluzo; a surge of the sea.
G2668: To sail down (from the high seas to the shore). From kata and pleo; to sail down upon a place, i.e. To land at.
G495: On the opposite side or shore. From anti and peran; on the opposite side.
G4884: To seize, drag by force. From sun and harpazo; to snatch together, i.e. Seize.
G12: The abyss, unfathomable depth, an especially Jewish conception, the home of the dead and of evil spirits.  Depthless, i.e. |abyss|.
G588: To receive, welcome, entertain (with hospitality), embrace. From apo and dechomai; to take fully, i.e. Welcome, approve.
G4321: To spend in addition. From pros and analisko; to expend further.
G598: (lit: I rub), jostle, press hard, crowd. From apo and thlibo; to crowd.
G1280: To be in trouble, doubt, difficulty; To be at a loss. From dia and aporeo; to be thoroughly nonplussed.
G1979: Provision, nourishment, food. From a compound of epi and a derivative of sitos; a provisioning, i.e. food.
G4895: To be with, come together with. From sun and eimi; to be in company with, i.e. Present at the time.
G1823: To flash forth like lightning, gleam, be radiant. From ek and astrapto; to lighten forth, i.e. to be radiant.
G1841: (a) an exit, going out, departure from a place; the exodus, (b) death. From ek and hodos; an exit, i.e. death.
G1235: To awake out of sleep, be thoroughly awake. From dia and gregoreuo; to waken thoroughly.
G4921: To place together, commend, prove, exhibit; instrans: I stand with; To be composed of, cohere.
G1316: To separate myself from, part from, go away. From dia and the middle voice of chorizo; to remove wholly, i.e. Retire.
G876: Foam, froth. Apparently a primary word; froth, i.e. Slaver.
G4876: To meet, encounter, fall in with. From sun and a derivative of anti; to meet with; figuratively, to occur.
G4317: From pros and ago; to lead towards, i.e. to conduct near, or to approach.
G3168: (divine) majesty or magnificence, glory. From megaleios; superbness, i.e. Glory or splendor.
G3871: To hide, conceal, veil. From para and kalupto; to cover alongside, i.e. Veil.
G143: To perceive, understand. Of uncertain derivation; to apprehend.
G4741: From a presumed derivative of histemi; to set fast, i.e. to turn resolutely in a certain direction, or to confirm.
G355: From ana and a form of the alternate of haireomai; properly, to use up, i.e. Destroy.
G1229: From dia and the base of aggelos; to herald thoroughly.
G2111: Suitable, fit, useful. From eu and a derivative of tithemi; well placed, i.e. appropriate.
G322: From ana and deiknuo; to exhibit, i.e. to indicate, appoint.
G704: A lamb, sheep. Perhaps the same as arrhen; a lamb.
G1879: To rest upon, rely on, trust in. Middle voice from epi and anapano; to settle on; literally or figuratively.
G631: To wipe off, wipe clean; mid: I wipe myself off. Middle voice from apo and masso; to scrape away.
G1449: To write, inscribe. From en and grapho; to |engrave|, i.e. Inscribe.
G613: To hide away, conceal, keep secret. From apo and krupto; to conceal away; figuratively, to keep secret.
G4045: From peri and pipto; to fall into something that is all around, i.e. Light among or upon, be surrounded with.
G2253: Half-dead. From a presumed compound of the base of hemisu and thnesko; half dead, i.e. Entirely exhausted.
G4795: A coincidence, accident, chance. From a comparative of sun and kureo; concurrence, i.e. Accident.
G492: To pass opposite, on the opposite side of the road. From anti and parerchomai; to go along opposite.
G3593: To journey, travel. From hodos; to travel.
G2611: To bind up, bandage. From kata and deo; to tie down, i.e. Bandage.
G1913: To place upon (a horse, mule). From epi and a reduplicated derivative of the base of basis; to cause to mount.
G3829: Neuter of a presumed compound of pas and a derivative of dechomai; all-receptive, i.e. A public lodging-place.
G1959: To take care of, attend to. Middle voice from epi and the same as melo; to care for.
G1880: To return, come back again. From epi and anerchomai; to come up on, i.e. Return.
G4325: To spend in addition. From pros and dapanao; to expend additionally.
G3136: Martha, sister of Mary and Lazarus of Bethany. Probably of Chaldee origin; Martha, a Christian woman.
G5264: From hupo and dechomai; to admit under one's roof, i.e. Entertain hospitably.
G3869: To sit down beside, set beside. From para and kathizo; to sit down near.
G4049: To distract, trouble greatly. From peri and spao; to drag all around, i.e. to distract.
G4878: From sun and antilambanomai; to take hold of opposite together, i.e. Co-operate.
G335: From a compound of a (compare aneu) and aidos; impudence, i.e. importunity.
G5609: An egg. Apparently a primary word; an |egg|.
G1270: A reasoning, thought, cogitation. From a compound of dia and noieo; something thought through, i.e. A sentiment.
G2528: To arm completely. From kata; and hoplizo; to equip fully with armor.
G3528: To conquer, be victorious, overcome, prevail, subdue. From nike; to subdue.
G1239: From dia and didomi; to give throughout a crowd, i.e. Deal out; also to deliver over.
G4661: Spoil taken from a foe. Neuter from skullo; something stripped, i.e. Booty.
G3304: Nay rather; indeed, truly, really. From Not Used and oun and ge; so then at least.
G1865: To gather together, pass: I crowd upon (some one), press around. From epi and athroizo; to accumulate.
G709: To breakfast, dine. From ariston; to take the principle meal.
G2926: A cellar, vault, hidden place, crypt. Feminine of kruptos; a hidden place, i.e. Cellar.
G4648: To look at, regard attentively, take heed, beware, consider. From skopos; to take aim at, i.e. regard.
G1751: To be in, within. From ennomos and eimi; to be within.
G4379: To touch lightly. From pros and psauo; to impinge, i.e. Lay a finger on.
G1567: To seek out, seek out after, require. From ek and zeteo; to search out, i.e.investigate, crave, demand, worship.
G653: To draw out by questioning. From apo and a derivative of stoma; to speak off-hand, i.e. To catechize.
G1748: To lie in wait (ambush) for, seek to entrap (hence: I defraud, deceive). From enedra; to lurk, i.e. plot assassination.
G2340: To hunt, seek to catch or entrap; met: I lay hold of. From thera; to hunt, i.e. to carp at.
G3461: A myriad, group of ten thousand, a ten thousand. From murioi; a ten-thousand; by extension, a |myriad| or indefinite number.
G4780: To conceal closely, cover up wholly. From sun and kalupto; to conceal altogether.
G626: To give a defense, defend myself (especially in a law court): it can take an object of what is said in defense.
G3312: A divider, partitioner, distributor. From merizo; an apportioner.
G2164: To bear well, bring a good harvest, yield abundantly. From eu and phoreo; to bear well, i.e. Be fertile.
G2876: A raven, crow. Perhaps from korennumi; a crow.
G3349: From a compound of meta and a collateral form of airo or perhaps rather aer; to raise in mid-air, i.e. suspend.
G3822: To make old, declare obsolete; pass: I grow old, become obsolete. From palaios; to make worn out, or declare obsolete.
G1311: To destroy, waste; hence met: I corrupt. From diaballo and phtheiro; to rot thoroughly, i.e. to ruin.
G4024: From peri and zonnumi; to gird all around, i.e. to fasten on one's belt.
G360: To unloose, unloose for departure, depart, return. From ana and luo; to break up, i.e. Depart.
G4620: A measured portion of grain or food. From sitos and metron; a grain-measure, i.e. ration.
G3182: To make drunk; pass: I become drunk. A prolonged form of methuo; to intoxicate.
G525: From apo and allasso; to change away, i.e. Release, remove.
G2694: To pull down, drag away. From kata and suro; to drag down, i.e. Arrest judicially.
G4233: An officer employed to execute judicial sentences. From a derivative of prasso; a practiser, i.e., an official collector.
G4611: Siloam, a spring within the walls, in the south-east corner of Jerusalem. Of Hebrew origin; Siloam, a pool of Jerusalem.
G289: A vine-dresser, gardener. From ampelos and ergon; a vine-worker, i.e. Pruner.
G2673: From kata and argeo; to be entirely idle, literally or figuratively.
G4794: To be bowed together, bent double. From sun and kupto; to stoop altogether, i.e. Be completely overcome by.
G352: To raise myself, look up, be elated. From ana and kupto; to unbend, i.e. Rise; figuratively, be elated.
G3838: Complete, entire, perfect, through all time. From pas and telos; full-ended, i.e. Entire.
G461: To make upright (straight) again, rear again, restore. From ana and a derivative of the base of orthos; to straighten up.
G480: To resist, oppose, withstand, lie opposite to. From anti and keimai; to lie opposite, i.e. Be adverse to.
G2617: From kata and aischunomai; to shame down, i.e. Disgrace or put to the blush.
G4197: A journey, pursuit, undertaking, progress. From poreuomai; travel; figuratively proceedings, i.e. Career.
G75: From agon; to struggle, literally, figuratively, or genitive case.
G608: To shut fast, close, shut up. From apo and kleio; to close fully.
G658: To complete, accomplish, form fully, perfect, bring to maturity. From apo and teleo; to complete entirely, i.e. Consummate.
G1735: To allow, it is possible. Third person singular present of a compound of en and dechomai; it is accepted in, i.e. Admitted.
G3555: A brood of young birds. From neossos; a brood.
G5203: Afflicted with dropsy. From a compound of hudor and a derivative of optanomai; to be |dropsical|.
G2270: From the same as hesuchios; to keep still, i.e. Refrain from labor, meddlesomeness or speech.
G385: To drag up, pull up, draw up, draw out. From ana and spao; to take up or extricate.
G470: To contradict, reply against, give a hostile answer. From anti and apokrinomai; to contradict or dispute.
G1907: From epi and echo; to hold upon, i.e. to retain; to detain; to pay attention to.
G4320: To go up to, come up to, go up further. From pros and anabaino; to ascend farther, i.e. Be promoted (more honorable) seat).
G511: Comparative degree of ano; upper, i.e. to a more conspicuous place, in a former part of the book.
G479: To invite in return. From anti and kaleo; to invite in return.
G468: A gift in return (for another), a return, recompense, requital. From antapodidomi; a requital.
G5585: To reckon, compute, calculate. From psephos; to use pebbles in enumeration, i.e. to compute.
G1615: To complete, bring to completion, carry out, perform. From ek and teleo; to complete fully.
G1011: To deliberate, take counsel, determine. From boule; to advise, i.e. deliberate, or resolve.
G4242: An embassy, delegation, eldership. From presbeuo; seniority, i.e. an embassy.
G1234: To murmur greatly, continue murmuring. From dia and gogguzo; to complain throughout a crowd.
G1244: To divide into parts, cut asunder, distribute. From dia and haireomai; to separate, i.e. Distribute.
G2769: A husk (pod) of the carob. Neuter of a presumed derivative of keras; something horned, i.e. the pod of the carob-tree.
G3407: A paid worker, hired servant, hireling (contrasted with a slave). From misthos; a wage-earner.
G1146: A finger-ring. From daktulos; a finger-ring.
G326: To come to life again, revive, regain life. To recover life.
G4858: Harmony of instruments, music. From sumphonos; unison of sound, i.e. A concert of instruments.
G943: Of Hebrew origin; a bath, or measure for liquids.
G1225: To thrust through, slander, complain of, accuse. From dia and ballo; to traduce.
G3622: Management of household affairs, stewardship, administration. From oikonomos; administration; specially, a |economy|.
G3621: To be a steward, manage a household. From oikonomos; to manage.
G5430: Wisely, sensibly, prudently. Adverb from phronimos; prudently.
G153: To be ashamed, be put to shame. From aischos; to feel shame.
G3179: Methistano meth-is-tan'-o from meta and histemi; to transfer, i.e. Carry away, depose or exchange, seduce.
G2884: (Hebrew) a (dry) measure, equivalent to 120 gallons. Of Hebrew origin; a cor, i.e. A specific measure.
G1867: To praise, commend, applaud. From epi and aineo; to applaud.
G1587: To fail, die out, come to an end, be defunct. From ek and leipo; to omit, i.e. cease.
G5366: Money-loving, avaricious, covetous. From philos and arguros; fond of silver, i.e. Avaricious.
G1592: To deride, scoff at, mock greatly. From ek and mukterizo; to sneer outright at.
G1669: To afflict with sores; pass: To be afflicted with sores. From helkos; to cause to ulcerate, i.e. be ulcerous.
G621: To lick off, lick clean, lick up. From apo and leicho; to lick clean.
G2711: To cool, refresh. From kata and psucho; to cool down, i.e. Refresh.
G5490: A gap, gulf, chasm. From a form of an obsolete primary chao; a |chasm| or vacancy.
G1263: To give solemn evidence, testify (declare) solemnly. From dia and martureo; to attest or protest earnestly, or hortatively.
G418: Impossible, inadmissible. Unadmitted, i.e. not supposable.
G4807: A sycamore tree, black mulberry tree. Of Hebrew origin in imitation of sukomoraia; a sycamore-fig tree.
G4207: From afar, far off, from a distance. From porrho with adverbial enclitic of source; from far, or at a distance, i.e. Distantly.
G241: Of another nation, a foreigner. From allos and genos; foreign, i.e. Not a Jew.
G3907: Observation, careful watching. From paratereo; inspection, i.e. Ocular evidence.
G797: To flash (with, then like, lightning), be lustrous. Probably from aster; to flash as lightning.
G2225: From the same as zoon and a derivative of ginomai; to engender alive, i.e. to rescue from death.
G1556: To give justice over, defend, avenge, vindicate. From ekdikos; to vindicate, retaliate, punish.
G5299: From a compound of hupo and a derivative of optanomai; to hit under the eye, i.e. to tease or annoy, subdue.
G1557: (a) a defense, avenging, vindication, vengeance, (b) full (complete) punishment. From ekdikeo; vindication, retribution.
G1848: To set at naught, ignore, despise. A variation of exoudenoo and meaning the same.
G3432: An adulterer, that is, a man who is guilty with a married woman. Perhaps a primary word; a paramour; figuratively, apostate.
G2433: (a) To have mercy on, show favor to, (b) trans. with object of sins: To forgive, pardon.
G3007: A primary verb; to leave, i.e. to fail or be absent.
G4179: Many times more, manifold. From polus and probably a derivative of pleko; manifold, i.e. very much more.
G754: Head of a custom-house, chief tax-gatherer or publican. From arche and telones; a principle tax-gatherer.
G4390: To run before, outrun, run in advance. From pro and trecho; to run forward, i.e. Outstrip, precede.
G5073: Four-fold, four times as much. From tessares and a derivative of the base of pleistos; quadruple.
G398: From ana and phaino; to show, i.e. appear, or to have pointed out.
G2104: (a) of noble birth, of high birth, (b) noble in nature. From eu and ginomai; well born, i.e. high in rank, or generous.
G4231: To transact business, trade. From pragma; to busy oneself with, i.e. To trade.
G1281: To gain by business (trading). From dia and pragmateuomai; to thoroughly occupy oneself, i.e. to earn in business.
G4333: To gain, produce in addition. From pros and ergazomai; to work additionally, i.e. acquire besides.
G606: To have been put away, be stored, be reserved for. From apo and keimai; to be reserved; figuratively, to await.
G4676: A handkerchief, napkin. Of Latin origin; a sudarium, i.e. Towel.
G840: Grim, severe, strict, exacting, harsh, rigid. From a derivative of the same as aer; rough, i.e. severe.
G1977: To throw (cast) (upon), as of cares. From epi and rhipto; to throw upon.
G5291: To spread under, strew under. From hupo and stronnumi; to strew underneath.
G3925: From a compound of para and emballo; a throwing in beside, i.e., battle-array, encampment or barracks.
G5482: A palisade, mound for besieging. From charasso; a stake, i.e. a palisade or rampart.
G4033: To encircle, surround, encompass. From peri and kukloo; to encircle all around, i.e. Blockade completely.
G1474: To dash to the ground, level with the ground. From edaphos; to raze.
G1984: From episkeptomai; inspection; by implication, superintendence; specially, the Christian |episcopate|.
G1582: To hang out, mid: I hang upon. Middle voice from ek and kremannumi; to hang upon the lips of a speaker, i.e. Listen closely.
G4817: To reason, reckon with myself, consider. From sun and logizomai; to reckon together, i.e. Deliberate.
G2642: To stone down, stone to death, overwhelm with stones. From kata and lithazo; to stone down, i.e. To death.
G5135: To wound. From trauma; to inflict a wound.
G2481: Perhaps, equally; it may be that. Adverb from isos; likely, i.e. Perhaps.

G3834: Shrewdness, skill; hence: cunning, craftiness. From panougos; adroitness, i.e. trickery or sophistry.
G2661: To deem (count) worthy. From kata and axioo; to deem entirely deserving.
G5177: (a) gen: I obtain, (b) absol: I chance, happen; ordinary, everyday, it may chance, perhaps.
G2465: Equal to or like the angels. From isos and aggelos; like an angel, i.e. Angelic.
G3377: Probably from the same base as massaomai and mnaomai; to disclose, i.e. Report, declare, intimate.
G5568: From psallo; a set piece of music, i.e. A sacred ode; collectively, the book of the Psalms.
G4422: To terrify, scare, strike with panic. Probably akin to the alternate of pipto or to petomai; to scare.
G5400: Neuter of a derivative of phobeo; a frightening thing, i.e. Terrific portent.
G4304: To meditate beforehand, prepare, get up, premeditate. From pro and meletao; to premeditate.
G2944: To encircle, besiege, surround. From the same as kukloi; to encircle, i.e. Surround.
G4760: An encamped army. From the base of stratia and the same as pedinos; a camping-ground, i.e. a body of troops.
G1633: To go out, depart from, withdraw, flee. From ek and choreo; to depart.
G163: To take captive (in war); I subdue, ensnare. From aichmalotos; to make captive.
G4535: The tossing of the sea in a tempest; agitation, rolling. Probably from the base of saino; a vibration, i.e., billow.
G674: To faint, breathe out life, die, be dismayed. From apo and psucho; to breathe out, i.e. Faint.
G4329: Expectation, waiting. From prosdokao; apprehension; by implication, infliction anticipated.
G629: From a compound of apo and lutron; ransom in full, i.e. riddance, or Christian salvation.
G4261: From pro and ballo; to throw forward, i.e. Push to the front, germinate.
G2897: Drunken dissipation, surfeiting. Probably from the same as harpazo; properly, a headache from drunkenness, i.e. a debauch.
G3178: Deep drinking, drunkenness. Apparently a primary word; an intoxicant, i.e. intoxication.
G982: Belonging to ordinary life, worldly. From a derivative of bioo; relating to the present existence.
G160: Unexpected, sudden. From a compound of a and phaino; unexpected, i.e. suddenly.
G1628: To flee out, away, escape; with an acc: I escape something. From ek and pheugo; to flee out.
G3719: To rise early, come in the morning. From orthros; to use the dawn, i.e. to repair betimes.
G4755: From the base of stratia and ago or hegeomai; a general, i.e. a governor, the chief of the temple-wardens.
G4934: Mid. and pass: To make a compact (agreement) with (together), covenant with, agree.
G3724: From horion; to mark out or bound, i.e. to appoint, decree, specify.
G5379: Love of dispute, contention. From philoneikos; quarrelsomeness, i.e. A dispute.
G2961: To have authority, rule over. From kurios; to rule.
G1850: To exercise (wield) power (authority), pass: To be ruled, be held under authority. From exousia; to control.
G2110: A benefactor, well-doer. From eu and the base of ergon; a worker of good, i.e. a philanthropist.
G1303: (a) I appoint, make (of a covenant), (b) I make (a will). Middle voice from dia and tithemi; to put apart, i.e. dispose.
G1809: To demand of, ask for, beg earnestly for. Middle voice from ek and aiteo; to demand.
G1617: More earnestly. Neuter of the comparative of ektenes; more intently.
G2361: A clot, large drop (of blood). Perhaps from trepho; a clot.
G3049: To reckon, count, charge with; reason, decide, conclude; think, suppose.
G1000: A casting, throw; in acc: as measure of distance. From ballo; a throw.
G1765: To invigorate, strengthen. From en and ischuo; to invigorate.
G4776: To cause to sit down with, sit down together. From sun and kathizo; to give a seat in company with.
G1339: To put apart, separate, put some distance between. From dia and histemi; to stand apart, i.e. to remove, intervene.
G1340: To assert emphatically, lean upon. From dia and a derivative of ischuros; to stout it through, i.e. Asservate.
G5279: To remind, remember, call to mind. From hupo and mimnesko; to remind quietly, i.e. Suggest to the memory.
G4244: Neuter of a presumed derivative of presbuteros; the order of elders, i.e., Israelite Sanhedrin or Christian |presbytery|.
G159: The cause, author; the culprit, the accused; the crime. From the same as aiteo; causative, i.e. a causer.
G2001: To persist, insist, be more urgent. From epi and ischuo; to avail further, i.e. insist stoutly.
G2159: Vehemently, powerfully, vigorously. Adverb from a compound of eu and a derivative of teino; in a well-strung manner, i.e. intensely.
G2986: From the same as lampas; radiant; by analogy, limpid; figuratively, magnificent or sumptuous.
G4391: To have been already, have been previously. From pro and huparcho; to exist before, i.e. to be or do something previously.
G2189: Enmity, hostility, alienation. Feminine of echthros; hostility; by implication, a reason for opposition.
G350: From ana and krino; properly, to scrutinize, i.e. investigate, interrogate, determine.
G3811: From pais; to train up a child, i.e. Educate, or, discipline.
G3826: All at once, all together. Dative case of a compound of pas and plethos; in full multitude, i.e. Concertedly or simultaneously.
G2019: To call out, shout, clamor at. From epi and phoneo; to call at something, i.e. Exclaim.
G1948: To decree, give sentence, decide. From epi and krino; to adjudge.
G5200: Moist, green, full of sap. From the base of huetos; wet, i.e. sappy.
G2557: (lit: an evil-worker), a criminal. From kakos and the base of ergon; a wrong-doer, i.e. Criminal.
G824: (lit: out of place, unusual, unbecoming), improper, unrighteous, perverse. Out of place, i.e. improper, injurious, wicked.
G4836: From sun and paraginomai; to be present together, i.e. To convene; by implication, to appear in aid.
G2335: A sight, spectacle. From the same as theoreo; spectatorship, i.e. a spectacle.
G4784: To give a vote with, assent to. Mid from sun and katatithemi; to deposit in company with, i.e. to accord with.
G2991: Hewn out of the rock. From a compound of las and the base of xeros; rock-quarried.
G2628: To follow after. From kata and akoloutheo; to accompany closely.
G3026: Folly, nonsense, idle talk. Apparently a primary word; twaddle, i.e. An incredible story.
G3879: To stoop, peer in, look down, look intently. From para and kupto; to bend beside, i.e. Lean over.
G3608: A linen bandage, a wrapping. Neuter of a presumed derivative of othone; a linen bandage.
G1695: Emmaus, a village not far from Jerusalem. Probably of Hebrew origin; Emmaus, a place in Palestine.
G474: To throw at in opposition, exchange (words) with, perhaps: I compare. From anti and ballo; to bandy.
G3939: To sojourn, dwell in as a stranger. From para and oikeo; to dwell near, i.e. Reside as a foreigner.
G3084: To release on receipt of ransom; mid: I redeem, release by paying ransom, liberate. From lutron; to ransom.
G3720: Early. From orthros; relating to the dawn, i.e. Matutinal.
G1021: Slow, slow of understanding. Of uncertain affinity; slow; figuratively, dull.
G1329: To translate, interpret, explain. From dia and hermeneuo; to explain thoroughly, by implication, to translate.
G4364: To pretend, regard, make a show of. Middle voice from pros and poieo; to do forward for oneself, i.e. Pretend.
G855: Disappearing, invisible, hidden. Non-manifested, i.e. Invisible.
G4867: To gather together, assemble. From sun and athroizo; to convene.
G1834: To lead, show the way; met: I unfold, narrate, declare. From ek and hegeomai; to consider out, i.e. Rehearse, unfold.
G5584: From the base of psallo; to manipulate, i.e. Verify by contact; figuratively, to search for.
G1034: Eatable, suitable for food. From brosis; eatable.
G3702: Roasted, broiled. From an obsolete verb akin to hepso; cooked, i.e. Roasted.
G4637: To dwell as in a tent, encamp, have my tabernacle. From skenos; to tent or encamp, i.e. to occupy or, to reside.
G2116: From euthus; to straighten; technically, to steer.
G286: A lamb (as a type of innocence, and with sacrificial connotation). Apparently a primary word; a lamb.
G2059: (a) I translate, explain, (b) I interpret the meaning of. From a presumed derivative of Hermes; to translate.
G2475: An Israelite, one of the chosen people of Israel, a Jew. From Israel; an |Israelite|, i.e. Descendant of Israel.
G3355: From metreo; a measurer, i.e., a certain standard measure of capacity for liquids.

G755: From arche and a compound of treis and klino; director of the entertainment.
G2772: A small coin; plur: small change. From keiro; a clipping, i.e. a coin.
G1640: Less, smaller; poorer, inferior. Or elatton el-at-tone'; comparative of the same as elachistos; smaller.
G5416: A scourge, lash, whip. Neuter of a derivative from the base of phragelloo; a whip, i.e. Roman lash as a public punishment.

G1712: A place of traffic, mart, market, market-house. Neuter from emporos; a mart.
G3530: Nicodemus, a member of the Sanhedrin. From nikos and demos; victorious among his people; Nicodemus, an Israelite.
G1304: To tarry, continue, stay in a place. From dia and the base of tribos; to wear through, i.e. Remain.
G137: Of Hebrew origin; ?Non, a place in Palestine.
G4530: Salim -- a place in Palestine. Probably from the same as saleuo; Salim, a place in Palestine.
G2214: A question, debate, controversy; a seeking, search. From zeteo; a searching, i.e. A dispute or its theme.
G2544: And yet, although, indeed. From kaitoi and ge; and yet indeed, i.e. Although really.
G3597: A journey, journeying, travel. From the same as hodoiporeo; travel.
G4542: A Samaritan woman. Feminine of Samareites; a Samaritess, i.e. Woman of Samaria.
G4798: To have dealings with. From sun and chraomai; to use jointly, i.e. to hold intercourse in common.
G242: To leap, leap up; of water: To spring up, bubble up.
G4353: A worshipper. From proskuneo; an adorer.
G312: To bring back word, report; I announce, declare. From ana and the base of aggelos; to announce.
G5072: Of four months, a period of four months. Neuter of a compound of tessares and men; a four months' space.

G4262: Pertaining to sheep. From probaton; relating to sheep, i.e. through which they were led into Jerusalem.
G2861: (lit: a diving or swimming place), a pool. A diving-place, i.e. Pond for bathing.
G1447: In the Hebrew, or rather, in the Aramaic dialect. Adverb from Hebrais; Hebraistically or in the Jewish language.

G1593: To escape, get clear of, deviate, withdraw. From ek and neuo; to slip off, i.e. Quietly withdraw.
G2227: To make that which was dead to live, cause to live, quicken. From the same as zoon and poieo; tovitalize.
G2045: To search diligently, examine. Apparently from ereo; to seek, i.e. to investigate.
G5085: From Tiberios; Tiberias, the name of a town and a lake in Palestine.
G424: To come up, go up, ascend. From ana and erchomai; to ascend.
G977: To eat. A reduplicated and prolonged form of an obsolete primary verb; to eat.
G4897: To enter together with, embark with. From sun and eiserchomai; to enter in company with.
G1670: To drag, draw, pull, persuade, unsheathe. Or helko hel'-ko; probably akin to haireomai; to drag.

G3164: To engage in battle, fight; hence: To strive, contend, dispute.
G4634: From skenos and pegnumi; the Festival of Tabernacles.
G3322: To be in the middle, be advanced midway. From mesos; to form the middle, i.e., to be half-way over.
G4220: Which of two, whether. Neuter of a comparative of the base of pou; interrogative as adverb, which, i.e. Is it this or that.

G4482: To flow, overflow with. A primary verb; for some tenses of which a prolonged form rheuo is used to flow.
G1944: From epi and a derivative of kataraomai; imprecated, i.e. Execrable.
G1888: In the very act. From epi and autos and a derivative of phor; in theft itself, i.e. in actual crime.
G1961: (a) I remain, tarry, (b) I remain in, persist in. From epi and meno; to stay over, i.e. Remain.

G1659: To free, set free, liberate. From eleutheros; to liberate, i.e. to exempt.

G3058: To revile a person to his face, abuse insultingly. From loidoros; to reproach, i.e. Vilify.
G2318: Devout, pious, God-fearing. From theos and sebomai; reverent of God, i.e. Pious.

G1101: From glossa and the base of kosmos; properly, a case i.e. a casket or purse.

G3506: To nod, make a sign, beckon. Apparently a primary verb; to |nod|, i.e., signal.

G3124: Malchus, a servant of the high-priest at Jerusalem. Of Hebrew origin; Malchus, an Israelite.
G2336: A repository, receptacle; a case, sheath, scabbard. From tithemi; a receptacle, i.e. Scabbard.

G4914: A custom, habit, practice. From a compound of sun and ethos; mutual habituation, i.e. Usage.

G3395: A mixture. From mignumi; a compound.

G1720: To breathe into, breathe upon. From en and phusao; to blow at or on.

G232: To fish. From halieus; to be a fisher, i.e. to fish.
G4371: Neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of pros and phago; something eaten in addition to bread, i.e. A relish.

G4951: To draw, drag, force away. Probably akin to haireomai; to trail.

G2589: A knower of the inner life (character, hearts). From kardia and ginosko; a heart-knower.

G4785: To be voted or classed with. From sun and a compound of kata and psephizo; to count down in company with, i.e. Enroll among.

G822: Breath, steam, vapor. From the same as aer; mist.
G5512: To mock, scoff, jest, jeer. From a derivative probably of cheilos; to throw out the lip, i.e. Jeer at.
G3325: To fill. From mestos; to replenish, i.e. to intoxicate.
